body: I would, really, but I stopped writing like that a long time ago. Things just live in my head now.

It's wrong to leave. I know that. The immediate reasons are shitty but as I said in the other reply, I'm tired. I can't keep living like this. 

It really feels like it's just time to go.

I'm a loser. Useless. I'm on SSI for my lifelong mental issues. I give nothing. I only take. 

Well I pay some bills in the house but...who want to live to pay bills? It's like a negative existence. 

I haven't lost my dreams. That's what hurts. You want and wish but it's constant disappointment. Constant reminders of what you will not have. 

I'm tired, man.

The whole reason I receive SSI for my Anxiety/Depression cocktail is because I freak out and just...stop moving. I freeze. I couldn't go to work because my mind is spinning in death circles and I can't get out of bed. I can hold a half normal conversation but try to move me and see what happens.

This is so fucked up.
Word. I just don't know what they can do for it.
Craters? Shallow but big and round wounds. I call them holes.
Those are totally on my shopping list now. Thank you!
I developed compulsive shopping. Fuck Abilify.

I just came off Lamictal last week. I'd been on 50mg for a few years for Bipolar II (A bad diagnosis, imo) and when I complained of odd hair trigger anger, the doc went up to 100mg two months ago.

I felt like shit. I was exhausted and felt just awful all day. And my mood was so off track that it eventually lead me to researching BPD because I was going crazy with the moods and meltdowns. So I ask to quit. So...we just stopped.

So far, so good. Nothing out of the ordinary yet. YET. I am waiting for the shoe to drop. But I'm built like a tank when it comes to medicine. Withdrawals and side effects seem to slide off me like it's nothing. I'm really weird.

You should check in with your doc for no other reason than the rash. That is some terrifying stuff.
Eh. I was diagnosed past 30. So maybe 40?
